propositions: 108 store tickets carry Success Criteria bullets instead of Acceptance Criteria checkboxes, making criteria invisible to blocking floors and not individually trackable.
The migration script must convert Success Criteria blocks to Acceptance Criteria checklist items through rebar.edit_ticket so changes are auditable ticket events, not direct git rewrites.
Rewriting ticket descriptions invalidates plan-review attestations as stale-material; the script skips in-flight open/in-progress tickets by default to avoid silently invalidating claimed work.
The live migration must handle variant heading formats (with qualifiers like 'target state') using prefix matching rather than exact string comparison to catch all SC blocks.
Post-migration verification confirms zero tickets remain with Success Criteria headings, all migrated tickets pass the AC floor (_count_ac_items >= 1), and idempotency holds across repeated runs.
